<!-- head-1: body_md -->
Additive changes to steady-state WoS (\cref{sec:bg:wos}) are highlighted in \textcolor{red!50!blue!75!white}{purple}.}
\label{alg:wos}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require Starting position $x \in \Omega$ of random walk, \textcolor{red!50!blue!75!white}{time budget $t>0$}, and $\varepsilon$-shell.
\Ensure Single-sample estimate $\hat{u}(x\textcolor{red!50!blue!75!white}{,t})$ of heat equation with spatially varying initial condition, source, and Dirichlet data.
<!-- end head-1 -->
<!-- head-2: body_md -->
Additive changes to steady-state WoSt (\cref{sec:bg:wost}) are highlighted in \textcolor{red!50!blue!75!white}{purple}.}
\label{alg:wost}
\begin{algorithmic}[1]
\Require Starting position $x \in \Omega$ of random walk, normal $n_x$ at $x$ (undefined if $x \notin \partial\Omega_{\mathrm{N}}$), \textcolor{red!50!blue!75!white}{time budget $t>0$}, and $\varepsilon$-shell.
\Ensure Single-sample estimate $\hat{u}(x\textcolor{red!50!blue!75!white}{,t})$ of heat equation with spatially varying initial condition, source, and mixed Dirichlet--Neumann data.
<!-- end head-2 -->
